blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540162 and Base block 48677278, canonical proxy 0x16f93ebc5320c89efc8701577efe49d14a276a06 resolves to the full-match verified ERC20F implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62. Current hasRole reads confirm 0x47a5059be8e1876346f4b854377baaa3c0e0d4eb holds PAUSER_ROLE on both chains. Its pause() function is PAUSER_ROLE-gated and every token transfer passes whenNotPaused; transfer and transferFrom also query the active nonzero access registry for both sender and receiver, while recoverTokens can transfer from an account without access. Direct global and holder-level transfer control therefore exists.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum remains CADD's reviewed canonical native-issuance route. Tetra lists the same issuer-controlled deployment on Base, but neither the issuer's public materials nor the verified ERC20F source proves independent Base reserve/liability reconciliation or identifies a supply-conserving bridge rail. Under the conservative boundary determination, Base is a bridge representation: its direct MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UUPS UPGRADER_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE surfaces are retained below, while the exact cross-chain mechanism, limits, peers, validators, and conservation invariant remain unresolved.

routes.protocol: CADD (CAD Digital native issuance on Ethereum)
routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain 2026-08-17 at Ethereum block 25774447 (2026-08-17T11:16:59Z): name 'CAD Digital Inc', symbol CADD, 18 decimals, and totalSupply() succeeded; the EIP-1967 implementation is 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62 and the issuer role graph confirms the canonical Ethereum mint surface. Tetra's terms state that each CADD issued is backed by CAD$1.00 held in trust and that redemption burns CADD on the applicable Supported Blockchain.

routes.protocol: CADD issuer-controlled Base representation (cross-chain mechanism unresolved)
routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain 2026-08-17 at Base block 50088040 (2026-08-17T11:17:07Z): name 'CAD Digital Inc', symbol 'CADD', totalSupply(), and the EIP-1967 implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62 all read successfully. MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE are active on Base, with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE as each role's admin. Tetra lists this address as CADD on Base, but no primary source proves independent Base reserve/liability reconciliation or identifies a bridge endpoint, adapter, peer, lockbox, validator, or route limit. The native-liability burden is therefore not met; Base is conservatively classified as a bridge representation with an unresolved route mechanism.

controls.label: CADD Base ERC20F representation MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: The verified ERC20F mint(address,uint256) path is onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) and has no numeric supply cap or per-minter allowance, so this current Base role holder can expand representation supply without an on-chain ceiling.

routeChecks.caps: The verified ERC20F source defines mint(address,uint256) as onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) with no numeric cap or per-minter allowance.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: No primary source or current Base contract read establishes that Base minting is bounded by a prior Ethereum burn/lock or by an independently reconciled Base reserve ledger; route-level conservation remains unverified.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Base block 50088040, MINTER_ROLE was held by 0x4b37dd8b..., getRoleAdmin(MINTER_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was held by 0xb3a77dd7.... All observed role EOAs delegate to Fireblocks' UniversalGaslessDelegate; signer custody is undisclosed.

controls.evidence: At Base block 50088040 (2026-08-17T11:17:07Z), hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x4b37dd8b672ba9f738d888e43ecfaf946cdcadd9) returned true, getRoleAdmin(MINTER_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and eth_getCode returned 0xef01000000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b. The source-verified ERC20F implementation gates mint(address,uint256) with MINTER_ROLE and does not define a numeric cap or bridge-specific conservation check. This is the identified current bridge-mint holder for the Base representation; the exact cross-chain route that would constrain or trigger the mint remains an evidence gap.

controls.label: CADD Base ERC20F representation DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the role administrator for MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE. It can grant or revoke those representation controls and can therefore replace the current minter, upgrade, or pause authority, but it did not itself hold those roles at the observation block.

routeChecks.caps: The ERC20F source imposes no numeric mint cap; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant MINTER_ROLE to another address, so the representation's mint authority is replaceable without an on-chain ceiling.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Base block 50088040, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was held by 0xb3a77dd7..., getRoleAdmin() for MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and no timelock or multisig was identified in the role graph.

controls.evidence: At Base block 50088040 (2026-08-17T11:17:07Z), hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb3a77dd7c30cdf4f30ae515f73d96f3f41593fce) returned true and eth_getCode returned the EIP-7702 delegation indicator for Fireblocks' UniversalGaslessDelegate. AccessControl's getRoleAdmin reads returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE, making this the administrator able to grant or replace the Base representation's mint, upgrade, and pause roles.

controls.label: CADD Base ERC20F representation UPGRADER_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: The Base token is a UUPS proxy and the verified ERC20F _authorizeUpgrade() path is onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE). This zero-delay role holder can replace the representation implementation and remove the current mint constraints.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Base block 50088040, UPGRADER_ROLE was held by 0x9367b51c..., getRoleAdmin(UPGRADER_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and no timelock was identified. An implementation replacement can change the Base representation's mint, burn, pause, and transfer behavior.

controls.evidence: At Base block 50088040 (2026-08-17T11:17:07Z), hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0x9367b51c7833f4ea32898079e7f4318e4f412b78) returned true, getRoleAdmin(UPGRADER_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and the EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62. The verified source gates _authorizeUpgrade() with UPGRADER_ROLE; this representation upgrade path has no delay. The role account delegates to Fireblocks' UniversalGaslessDelegate and its signer custody policy is undisclosed.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Base block 50088040, PAUSER_ROLE was held by 0x47a5059b..., getRoleAdmin(PAUSER_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and paused() returned false. The verified ERC20F pause path is PAUSER_ROLE-gated and applies to token transfers and mint/burn operations.

controls.evidence: At Base block 50088040 (2026-08-17T11:17:07Z), hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, 0x47a5059be8e1876346f4b854377baaa3c0e0d4eb) returned true, getRoleAdmin(PAUSER_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and paused() returned false. This is the pause authority for the reviewed Base representation; it is not asserted as evidence of a bridge protocol or validator.
